name: agentattest
description: Local-first provenance receipts for agent-assisted git changes.

scripts.smoke: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js --help && node -e "const {mkdtempSync}=require('node:fs'); const {tmpdir}=require('node:os'); const {join,resolve}=require('node:path'); const {execFileSync}=require('node:child_process'); const cwd=mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(),'agentattest-smoke-')); execFileSync(process.execPath,[resolve('dist/src/cli.js'),'init'],{cwd,stdio:'inherit'});"
scripts.release:check: npm test && npm run smoke && npm run package:smoke

author: Roger Chappel
